decisions.reason: As software close to the core offer, process data archiving and reporting costs little to maintain and fits the firm's move toward data-driven infrastructure management, so the option is worth keeping open even though its sibling Product B was consolidated away.

Flow measurement automation software is a low-cost, close-to-core option whose value is still unfolding with the shift to connected, web-based operation, and no evidence yet shows its value is unlikely to be realized.
